literal_meaning: মুখে জল আসা (water coming to the mouth)
figurative_meaning_en: To feel a strong temptation to eat or salivate at the thought of food
example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই গরম পুরি দেখে ছেলেটির মুখে জল এসে গেল।
বাজারের ফল দেখে আমার মুখে জল আসছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Seeing those hot puris made the boy's mouth water.
Looking at the fruits in the market is making my mouth water.
note: This idiom vividly captures the physiological response to appealing food, deeply embedded in Bengali daily life and expressions of appetite.
